ShortDescription.Value: An in-game journal for your city. Your City Manager (Claude) plans between sessions, and you build.

Publish.LongDescription:
# City Manager
You build the city. Your City Manager keeps the plans.
I made City Manager because the planning was always my biggest problem in CS2. As my city grew, I'd leave projects half-done, give up on the city and start over. I didn't want a mod that builds things for me, though: I still wanted to *play*. So this is a journal inside the game, kept by a City Manager (Claude, Anthropic's AI, in Claude Code on your own computer) and modeled after the greatest City Manager of all time, Ben Wyatt. Before you play, it writes the plan. After you play, it looks at what you built and gets the next one ready. No AI runs while you play.
## What it does
- A journal panel (Ctrl+J or the cones button): Today, Projects, Notes, Wrap-up and City - Tonight's to-do list, with anything you didn't get to carried over - Projects of any size, with steps to tick off, build cards and *Show on map* - Notes pinned to wherever you're looking, answered by your City Manager next time - A quick wrap-up, plus what changed since you loaded the city - Plans drawn over your city with City Planning Draft, with the exact road pieces to use - A founding chat for a brand-new city, or a takeover of the city you already have - Works fine on its own as a notebook, no Claude needed
## Getting started
1. Subscribe. City Planning Draft comes with it. 2. Install the Claude Code plugin. In the Claude desktop app's Code tab: **Plugins → Add → Add marketplace → Add from a repository**, paste https://github.com/mayorgergich/cs2-city-manager, press **Sync**, then install it. In Claude Code in a terminal: **/plugin install city-manager --marketplace mayorgergich/cs2-city-manager** 3. In the game, load your city (or make a new one), press **Ctrl+J** and pick *Start a new journal for this city*. That takes the snapshot your City Manager reads from. Save, then close the game or go back to the main menu. 4. In Claude Code, type **/city-manager:city-manager** and follow along. A new city gets founded properly, with its first roads and planner drafts. A city you already have gets a tour and a plan for what's next. 5. After that, it's the same command before and after every session: a plan before you play, and a report after you press *Done for today* and save. Keep Claude closed while you play.
## Please read
- **Made with AI.** I do have minor coding experience, but I could never have built this without AI: Claude wrote the code, working closely with me, and no experienced programmer has reviewed it yet. Reviews are very welcome. - **Privacy.** The mod never goes online and sends nothing to me. When you use Claude, your journal and city snapshot go to Anthropic under your own Claude account. The full security report is on GitHub. - **Claude Code needs a paid Claude plan.** Without it, City Manager still works as a notebook. - **Beta.** I play on Linux, so no Windows player has tested it yet. English only. - **Made for my own games.** I keep improving it as I play, and I'm sharing it in case it helps you too. Results may vary!
How to use it, step by step: https://github.com/mayorgergich/cs2-city-manager/blob/main/docs/guide.md GitHub (code, setup, security report): https://github.com/mayorgergich/cs2-city-manager Discord: https://discord.gg/Rtea83Gnb9
Publish.ChangeLog:
0.9.0 - The city snapshot now records the map: its name and theme, the traffic side, the game mode, the New Game options, and every link off the map (road, rail, air, ship, power and water), so the City Manager doesn't have to ask. - The build list the City Manager plans from now has the road menu's roundabouts and traffic-light pieces, and names Road Builder roads. - A step can carry its own build card: Picture and Show on map buttons under the step. - The panel's text follows the game's text size setting (Options, Interface).
0.8.0 First public beta: the journal panel (Today, Projects, Notes, Wrap-up, City), the city snapshot for the City Manager, and a floating, resizable window.
Publish.Disclosure: Made with AI: Claude, Anthropic's AI, wrote the code and most of the text, working closely with me. I do have minor coding experience, but no experienced programmer has reviewed it yet. The mod itself contains no AI and never goes online. Claude runs only in Claude Code on your own computer, between play sessions, if you choose to use it.
